[[File:Clayton Atkins DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|First Star Wars CCG World Championship appearance, [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Clayton Atkin''' (DeckTech handle '''TheDohMan''')<ref name="dt-23438">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23438 Atkins’ Alderaan 2nd Place TDIGWATT], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 20 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23438/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23438/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009162620/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23438/ Wayback Machine].</ref> finished 2nd at [[2002 Alderaan Regionals]] with a [[Dark]] [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]] list (''Atkins’ Alderaan 2nd Place TDIGWATT''). He played the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]<ref name="sat34" /> and the [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]]. He was listed as 2000 California State Champion on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]].<ref name="red32-home">[https://web.archive.org/web/20210513214727/https://cmikehardy.tripod.com/starwarsccg.htm Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site] (Wayback, 13 May 2021)</ref><ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-endor-grand-prix/ 2022 Endor Grand Prix], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021001109/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2022-endor-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]</ref>
